Question: Which of the given formulas of PL is the best symbolization of the following sentence?
Since the university raised tuition, the president approved of it and the board didn't prevent it.

Options: 
A. U • (P ⊃ ~B)
B. U ⊃ (P ∨ ~B)
C. (U ∨ P) • B
D. U ⊃ (~P • ~B)
E. (U ⊃ P) • B
F. U ⊃ (P • B)
G. (~U ⊃ P) • B
H. B ⊃ (U • P)
I. (P • ~B) ⊃ U
J. U ⊃ (P • ~B)

Provide the correct letter choice in \boxed{X}, where X is the correct letter choice. Keep the explanation or feedback within 3 sentences.
